newsitem.title: USA: Bayer unit gets new FDA okay on Cipro.
newsitem.headline: Bayer unit gets new FDA okay on Cipro.

text.p: Bayer Corp said on Monday that its Pharmaceutical Division has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market Cipro I.V. and Cipro tablets for treatment of intra-abdominal infections caused by E. coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Proteus mirabilis, Klebsiella pneumoniae, or Bacteroides fragilis.

The company said that it has marketed Cipro in the U.S. since 1987 for the treatment of a wide variety of infectious diseases in adults, including infections of the urinary tract, lower respiratory area, bones and joints and skin.
Bayer Corp is a unit of Germany's Bayer AG.
